_comment: Strict superset of production LTX-2 shapes. Adding entries is fine; removing requires a new image tag (hash changes). 1080p@241f is excluded: the VAE decoder's intermediate activation exceeds 2^31 elements and F.pad throws an int32-indexing error. 10-second video (241 frames) is only available at <=720p for the soft launch. 'Nominal 720p' is served as 1280x736 / 736x1280 because the LTX-2 VAE spatial_compression_ratio=32 requires all output dims to be multiples of 32; ltx.py's field validator rounds customer requests of 720 up to 736.
